What it carries

  • RFID protection, so your contactless cards stay silent to skimmers

  • High-quality elastic that keeps everything shut
  • Extremely slim and lightweight
  • Colours: Black, Brown, Black Gold and Brown Gold

Who it is for

For anyone who carries cards rather than a stack of notes and wants a wallet that disappears in the pocket. With 169 verified reviews averaging 4.6 stars, it is one of our most-reviewed pieces.

Care

Wipe with a soft dry cloth, keep it out of rain and direct heat for long periods, and condition it with a little leather balm every few months. Real leather softens and darkens slowly with use, which is the point.

Does RFID protection really matter?
Contactless cards can be read from a short distance. The RFID layer blocks that signal while the cards are inside the wallet.

Will it fit notes?
Yes, one section is for cash. It is built for a slim carry, so fold notes once.
